Services tailored to the challenges of industry, from logistics to quality.

### Logistics {.unlisted}

- Logistics dashboard: inventory, supply, shipments
- Demand analysis: seasonality, variability
- Cost analysis and carrier benchmarking
- Planning automation: supply, production, transport
- Inventory optimization and data reliability improvement

::: {.col}

### Quality {.unlisted}

- Quality dashboard: non-conformities, customer complaints, certifications, service level
- Routine automation: supplier monitoring, lab test results
- Quality analysis: non-conformities, supplier performance
- Traceability file automation (audits)
:::
:::


::: {.col}
::: {.prestation .prestation-general}
### General {.unlisted}

- Project scoping: data source mapping, roadmap (1 day)
- Data audit: review of existing tools with recommendations (2 to 3 days)
- Team support for adopting new tools (dashboards, automation)
:::
:::
